name: marketing-blog-cards
title: Blog Cards
description: Article preview cards for blog index pages and content sections, combining post image, date, title, excerpt, and optional CTA in bordered, floating-image, gradient-border, icon, and artistic layout styles.
useWhen: Displaying a grid or list of blog post previews on a blog index page or marketing site section.
Linking to related articles at the bottom of a post or landing page.
Showcasing a mix of content types (articles, tutorials, case studies) on a resources page.
avoidWhen: Displaying more than six to eight cards without pagination — use a paginated list instead.
The content is product or eCommerce items — use product-cards instead.
A single featured post needs prominence — use a full-width hero section rather than a card.
responsiveBehavior: Card grids collapse from three columns on desktop to two on tablet and one on mobile. Floating-image and artistic variants may reflow their image position to stacked on small screens.
accessibility: Card images must have descriptive alt text describing the post topic, not just 'blog image'.
Card titles should be heading elements (<h2> or <h3>) within a list or grid context.
If the entire card is a link, use an <a> wrapping the card with an aria-label for the full post title.

variants.title: Bordered with image, date, title and excerpt, shadow on hover
variants.description: Bordered blog card with a top image, publication date, post title, and excerpt that gains a drop shadow on hover — the standard blog grid card pattern.
accessibility: Post image alt text should describe the image content; title uses a heading element; date uses <time datetime>.

variants.title: Bordered with image, date, title and excerpt, shadow on hover (Dark)
variants.description: Standard bordered blog card adapted for dark marketing surfaces with dark card background and light text.
accessibility: Title, excerpt, and date text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Floating image with title and excerpt
variants.description: Blog card where the featured image floats at the top with a slight overlap into the card body, giving a layered depth effect.
accessibility: Floating image alt describes the post topic; ensure overlapping does not obscure heading text.

variants.title: Floating image with title and excerpt (Dark)
variants.description: Floating-image blog card adapted for dark surfaces, with the card body and text visible on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Text content beneath the floating image must remain legible on dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Bordered with image, title, excerpt and call to action
variants.description: Blog card with a full-width image, title, excerpt, and an explicit 'Read more' CTA link at the bottom — for collections where each post needs a clear entry point.
accessibility: CTA link should include the post title in its accessible name, e.g. 'Read more about Topic' via aria-label.

variants.title: Bordered with image, title, excerpt and call to action (Dark)
variants.description: CTA-equipped blog card adapted for dark surfaces with visible link and excerpt on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: CTA link text and image alt must maintain contrast on dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Gradient border with date, title and tags, animated gradient on hover
variants.description: Blog card with a gradient border that animates on hover, plus date, title, and topic tags — a visually distinctive style for developer blogs and design publications.
accessibility: Gradient border is decorative — ensure title and tag text contrast meets WCAG AA against the card background, not the border.

variants.title: Gradient border with date, title and tags, animated gradient on hover (Dark)
variants.description: Animated-gradient-border blog card adapted for dark surfaces with tags and title legible on dark card backgrounds.
accessibility: Title, date, and tag text must meet contrast requirements on dark card body backgrounds.

variants.title: Bordered with icon, title, excerpt and call to action, shadow on hover
variants.description: Blog card that replaces the photo with a category icon, suited for text-heavy content like documentation, tutorials, and reference guides.
accessibility: Category icon is decorative when the title describes the post; set aria-hidden='true' on the icon element.

variants.title: Bordered with icon, title, excerpt and call to action, shadow on hover (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-based blog card adapted for dark surfaces with icon, title, and excerpt visible on dark card backgrounds.
accessibility: Icon fill and text content must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Artistic with rotated date, image, title, excerpt and call to action, shadow on hover
variants.description: Stylized blog card with a rotated date stamp, full image, title, excerpt, and CTA — for editorial and creative publications where visual flair matters.
accessibility: Rotated date text must still meet contrast requirements; ensure rotation does not make the text unreadable.

variants.title: Artistic with rotated date, image, title, excerpt and call to action, shadow on hover (Dark)
variants.description: Artistic rotated-date blog card adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: All text including rotated date must meet contrast requirements on dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Background image with overlay containing date, title and excerpt
variants.description: Full-bleed background image card with a semi-transparent overlay showing date, title, and excerpt — for magazine-style and editorial content sections.
accessibility: Text on image overlay must meet WCAG AA contrast against the darkened image; avoid relying solely on the overlay color.
